verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a cloud platform, since some cloud vendors ship on-premises or customer-hosted editions. However, the evidence shows only a managed service running on CoreWeave's own infrastructure. CKS is described as letting you "run clusters on bare metal servers in CoreWeave Cloud," and the Terraform provider and APIs only manage CoreWeave-hosted resources. No self-hostable or on-premises distribution of the core product is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
